caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb027 WHERE cl0262 IS NULL

caveats.statement: Driver full name is split across cl0255 and cl0256; searching only one column misses matches
caveats.check_sql: SELECT cl0255, cl0256 FROM tb025 LIMIT 5

caveats.statement: Card power '*' means infinite, not a numeric value; numeric comparisons will fail
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb004 WHERE cl0143 = '*'

caveats.statement: Transaction yearmonth is stored as 'YYYYMM' string; month filtering must use substring
caveats.check_sql: SELECT DISTINCT cl0193 FROM tb014 LIMIT 5

caveats.statement: Gas station country uses ISO3 codes ('CZE','SVK'), not full names
Card power can be stored as '*' or NULL for unknown values, so numeric comparisons must exclude them
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb004 WHERE cl0143 = '*' OR cl0143 IS NULL

caveats.statement: Card language is stored in a separate table (tb005), so joining is required to filter by language
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb005 WHERE cl0163 = 'Chinese Simplified'

caveats.statement: Card legality requires joining tb006 on card id and filtering both format and status
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb006 WHERE cl0164 = 'commander' AND cl0165 = 'Legal'

caveats.statement: Lap times are stored as text like 'M:SS.mmm', so numeric comparison requires parsing; some rows may be NULL for drivers who did not finish.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb027 WHERE cl0262 IS NULL

caveats.statement: Race dates may be stored as text or datetime; year/month extraction must handle both formats.
Card base set numbers may be stored as text; numeric comparison requires casting.
Power/toughness column cl0143 uses both NULL and '*' to mean unknown, so filtering only one misses cards
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb004 WHERE cl0143 IS NULL OR cl0143 = '*'

caveats.statement: Transaction time stored as string; must use BETWEEN '08:00:00' AND '09:00:00' on cl0194
caveats.check_sql: SELECT cl0194 FROM tb013 WHERE cl0194 BETWEEN '08:00:00' AND '09:00:00' LIMIT 5

caveats.statement: Full names are split across cl0322 and cl0323; must concatenate to match 'Elijah Allen'
caveats.check_sql: SELECT cl0322, cl0323 FROM tb043 WHERE cl0322 = 'Elijah' AND cl0323 = 'Allen'

caveats.statement: Champion finish time format differs from other drivers; only champion shows hour:minutes:seconds.millisecond
caveats.check_sql: SELECT cl0262 FROM tb027 WHERE cl0262 LIKE '%:%:%' LIMIT 5
